openQuestions: Where do the support pages' user guides and quick guides link to (PDF host and URL pattern)? The fetched text names them but shows no URLs.
Which of the older models (LiNX Quattro, OMNIA, ONE, LiNX 3D, Enzo 3D, Enzo2) are still current, and are they linked from the catalog?
Does the catalog page list all models, including those whose model URLs lack the resound- prefix?

archive.text: The Web Archive has copies of /en-us from 2018 to 2026 (latest 20261109231147), and of the en-us catalog page from 2019 to 2026 (latest 20260809080829).

links.text: Every page links to resoundpro.com, the professional site. The sitemap also lists pro.resound.com pages.
The pages link to gn.com, resoundchina.com, jabra.dk, gnresoundblog.com, va.gov, and social networks. The en-us home page also links to resoundhearsay.com.
The Danish locale links to shop.resoundpatientsupport.com.
The English international Auracast page links to gnhearing.com.
The en-us Assist page lists one PDF on resound.com under /-/media/resound/resound-us/downloads/guides/. The report also lists PDFs on cdn1-originals.webdamdb.com and links to gngroup.webdamdb.com.

next.text: Check that the catalog page links all models in the sitemap, including slugs without the resound- prefix (enzo-q, enzo-3d, enzo2), because the current modelUrlPattern requires resound-.
Crawl the /en-us/help/hearing-aids/{slug} pages for document links, and check the PDF URL format since the report lists only one PDF on resound.com.
Check whether the Canadian en-ca and international en catalogs list models that en-us lacks.

render.text: All fetched pages report needsRender false and no failures occurred, so plain HTTP fetches are enough.
The pages repeat a large navigation and footer block, so the model-specific content comes late in the text.
The report found no JSON-LD types on any page.

structure.text: robots.txt lists two sitemaps: /en-us/xmlsitemap and /en/sitemapindex. It disallows only /sitecore/content and */1000$.

The report fetched per-locale xmlsitemap files (ar-sa, cs-cz, da, de-at, de-ch, de-de, en-au, en-ca, en-gb, en-in, en-us, es-es, es-ln, fi-fi, fr-ch, fr-fr, it-it, ja-jp). The sitemaps hold 666 URLs in total; the largest sections are /en (207), /da (155), /en-us (155) and /en-ca (149).
Locale prefixes come first in the URL, for example /en-us, /en-ca, /en and /da. The same path structure repeats under each prefix.
Model page template: /en-us/hearing-aids/resound-hearing-aids/{slug}, with 12 URLs in the sitemap. The report lists enzo-3d, enzo-q and enzo2 as examples.

Support page template: /en-us/help/hearing-aids/{slug}, with 11 URLs. The report lists enzo-ia, enzo-q and key as examples. Accessory support is at /en-us/help/accessories/{slug} and app support at /en-us/help/apps/{slug}.

Model pages with a sub-path exist, for example /hearing-aids/resound-hearing-aids/quattro/{slug}. The sitemap also holds placeholder or link-resolver URLs such as /hearing-aids/LINK_Placeholder and /hearing-aids/~/link.aspx?_id=..., which a scraper should skip.
Press pages sit at /en-us/press/{slug}, and the sitemap marks each page with hreflang alternates for all locales.

what.text: The site is ReSound's brand site; the footer names GN Hearing A/S, Ballerup, Denmark as the owner.
The start page sells no hearing aids directly: it presents ReSound hearing aids, apps and accessories and refers visitors to hearing care professionals.

where.text: The en-us catalog is /en-us/hearing-aids/resound-hearing-aids. The report fetched model pages for Sensia, Vivia, Nexia, Enzo IA, Savi, Key, and the en-us sitemap also lists Enzo Q, Enzo 3D and Enzo2.
Model slugs are not uniform. Sensia, Vivia, Nexia, Enzo IA, Savi and Key are served as resound-{name}, while the sitemap examples enzo-q, enzo-3d and enzo2 have no resound- prefix.
Support hub for hearing aids: /en-us/help/hearing-aids, which lists Sensia, Vivia, Enzo IA, Savi, Nexia, OMNIA, LiNX Quattro, ENZO Q, Key and other ReSound hearing aids.

The Key support page lists user guides (RIE, RIE rechargeable, BTE, BTE power, custom, chargers) and quick guides for Key 61/62/67/77/88/98. The Enzo IA page lists a brochure, a user guide and a quick guide. The ENZO Q page lists a user guide, brochure, pairing guide and quick guides.
Accessory support: /en-us/help/accessories, and /en-us/help/accessories/multi-mic lists Multi-Mic+ and Micro Mic guides.

App support: /en-us/help/apps, and /en-us/help/apps/smart-3d lists a pairing guide and user guides. The Smart 3D app is on iOS (id 1134918918) and Android (dk.resound.smart3d). The Smart app and Relief app are also described.
The Relief tinnitus app has its own iOS id 928432517 and Android id com.gnresound.tinnitus.

summary.text: resound.com is the live, multi-locale ReSound (GN Hearing) brand site; the en-us catalog at /en-us/hearing-aids/resound-hearing-aids lists model pages with plain HTML, and documents are on per-model /en-us/help/hearing-aids/{model} support pages.
